title: Patch: every menu fits one screen, desktop and phone, with a guard that keeps it so
thread:
**Issue #1581 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1581: Patch: every menu fits one screen, desktop and phone, with a guard that keeps it so Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul). Read the tracker's Goals first. Blocked by #1578 Blocked by #1579 Blocked by #1580 ## What After Play, Collection and Shop are reshaped, sweep **every remaining menu screen** (account, settings, leaderboard, stats, patch notes, replays, series/lobby pickers, invite, almanac and whatever else the planner finds; not the board, not the static legal pages) so each fits a single viewport with **no page scrolling** at a desktop size and a phone size. Allowed to scroll (the tracker's exceptions): - a big list of cards (collection, deck builder, almanac lists), inside its own region; - the tavern home, which is its main screen plus exactly one screen below the floor. Fix by layout (denser grids, tabs, collapsing secondary text), not by shrinking type below what is readable on a phone. ## Done when - A check that fails when a menu scrolls: e.g. a Cypress spec (component or full) that visits each menu route at a desktop and a phone viewport and asserts the document does not scroll vertically (`scrollHeight <= innerHeight`), with the exceptions above listed explicitly in the spec. The planner picks where it runs (the `e2e smoke` job if it fits its budget, else `super.yml`). - Every menu passes it. - The viewport sizes are named constants, not literals scattered through the spec. ## Plan _Written by `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39735895034)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Every menu (every screen except the boards and the static legal pages) stops scrolling the page at a desktop **1280x720** and a phone **390x844**. Its top (Back, the gear, its title) stays put, and whatever is taller than the room scrolls inside the menu's one region. The tavern home alone may be two screens tall. A new Cypress spec, `46`, visits every menu at both sizes and fails when the document is taller (or wider) than its allowance, with the exceptions listed in it. It joins the per-pull-request `e2e smoke`. The sizes are named constants in `e2e/support/config.ts`, and the rule is ruling R1581000. **What the planner measured** (page overflow in px, desktop/phone): - `/login` +22/+49; sign-up +204/+172 - `/account` +401/+288; `/leaderboard` +296/+143 - `/practice` +629/+1056; `/creator` 0/+487; `/together` 0/+117 - `/patch-notes` +2054/+2691; `/stats` +15446/+30001 - `/almanac` 0/+59203; `/decks` with a deck open 0/+48886 - `/series/:id` +95/+553, more with its explainer open Every other menu already passes. With the CSS below injected, every menu measured 0 at both sizes and at 360x740. ## Files to touch | File | | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/index.css` | change | new "one screen" section: `.one-screen`, `__frame`, `__body`, `__stack` | | `apps/web/src/auth/tavern.css` | change | `.tavern.app-shell.one-screen` bottom padding, compact site footer | | `apps/web/src/routes/login.tsx` | change | classes on root and panel | | `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx` | change | classes; wrap the panel's content after its `h2` | | `apps/web/src/routes/leaderboard.tsx` | change | same as account; body `tabIndex={0}` | | `apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx` | change | `Shell` lobby class; wrap the setup's content | | `apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx` | change | root class | | `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx` | change | `.creator` body class | | `apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.tsx` | change | root class, `.together-layout` body class | | `apps/web/src/routes/patch-notes.tsx` | change | root class, `main` body class | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` | change | root class, body class on both `.stats-panel` | | `apps/web/src/routes/series.tsx` | change | class on both roots; wrap explainer through `.play-layout` | | `apps/web/src/routes/replays.tsx` | change | root class; wrap the import and both sections | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` | change | phone one-screen height | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` | change | phone `.ws-layout` region | | `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.css` | change | phone `.almanac-main` region | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | one paragraph on the classes | | `e2e/support/config.ts` | change | `viewports`, `MenuViewport` | | `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` | new | the guard | | `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs` | change | `SMOKE` gains `"46"`; `WEIGHTS` gains `"46": 50`; comments | | `e2e/README.md` | change | title count, networked list, smoke list | | `BUILD.md` | change | §4 E2E line: add 46 to the per-PR specs | | `spec/rulings/R1581000.md` | new | the ruling | | `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | one paragraph at the end | | `spec/INDEX.md` | change | regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index` | **Do not touch:** `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `crates/`, the Play hub, Collection and Shop (already one screen), the board, the legal pages, `settings/`, spec 38 and its exceptions. **Governing rulings:** R1578000, R1579000 and R1580000 (their "the page never scrolls, a body does"), and the new R1581000. There is no engine, card or catalog change and no patch fragment. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/index.css`**: right after the `.app-shell { … }` block (line ~112), add exactly the rules below, one declaration per line as the file does: ```css /* --- one screen (#1581, R1581000) ---------------------------------------------------------- A menu is one screen: its root takes `one-screen`, the shell is the window's height and the page never scrolls. Its one region, `one-screen__body`, scrolls inside itself when the menu holds more than its room; `one-screen__frame` lets a box between the two shrink (a tavern panel); `one-screen__stack` stacks a wrapper's children as the shell would. Under 501 px tall (a phone on its side) the page scrolls as before. */ @media (min-height: 501px) { .app-shell.one-screen { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; min-height: 0; } .app-shell.one-screen > * { flex-shrink: 0; } .app-shell.one-screen .one-screen__frame { flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0; } .app-shell.one-screen .one-screen__body { flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; } } .app-shell.one-screen .one-screen__stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: inherit; } .app-shell.one-screen .one-screen__stack > * { flex-shrink: 0; } ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/auth/tavern.css`**: after the `.tavern.app-shell > * { … }` block (line ~89), add a comment citing R1581000 and: ```css @media (min-height: 501px) { .tavern.app-shell.one-screen { min-height: 0; padding-bottom: 14px; } .tavern.app-shell.one-screen .site-footer { padding: 8px var(--tavern-gutter) 0; } .tavern.app-shell.one-screen .site-footer__links { padding: 0; } } ``` 3. **TSX.** Append the class to the existing `className` string and change nothing else. - **`login.tsx`** (`return` at ~1027): - The root becomes `"app-shell auth-screen tavern one-screen"`. - `

`. That covers the `h1`, the banners, the notice, `TutorialPath`, the header and `PracticeSetup`. - **`creator.tsx`** (~47): add ` one-screen` to the root. - **`creator/Creator.tsx`** (~437): `className="creator one-screen__body"`. - **`TogetherRoute.tsx`** (~378): - Add ` one-screen` to the root. - Add ` one-screen__body` to `

The constants come from `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts` and `cardId` from `support/cards.ts`. - **Structure:** - Loop `for (const viewport of [viewports.desktop, viewports.phone])`, each a `describe(\`${viewport.label}, ${w}x${h}\`)` with `beforeEach(cy.viewport(…))`. - Inside it, a "signed out" and a "signed in" `describe`; the signed-in one has `before(() => cy.freeAccount(accounts.p1()))`. - One `it(\`R1581000
